notes.title: Update June 2017
notes.content:
Drive By Hero's first update is now live!

Intro voice over removed. 
Max Zombie generation reduced. 
Max health for Enemies halved. 
Updated Gun firing sounds. 
Material on machine gun edited to allow for lighting 
Weapon Swap implemented. (1 = Handgun, 2 = Machine Gun) 
UI element to notify the player that they got an upgrade 
Removed old music
Added in a music track per level

Environment:
Fog Reduced  
New texture for the side of the road
Planter added to base of trees 
Environment light darkened 
Street lamps added

We are working to fix the other issues and we want to again thank people who have participated in the game's improvement with their feedback.

The team

notes.title: Day 1
notes.content:
We have seen all your messages and we want to thank all the people who have made constructive reviews. As mentioned in the Early Access description, we will consider feedback from the community to improve this game. 

Thank to the community and the reviews received, we know that we need to improve the following points:

 Enemy AI
 Weapon sounds
 Voice acting 
 Weapon transition
 Collision with enemies
 Aiming
 Achievement system
 Difficulty in the level 3
